✦ Setup

Up and running in
three steps.

1
Add the bot

Click "Add to Discord" and authorize GH Notify to join your server. No special permissions needed beyond sending messages.

2
Run /setup

Go to the channel where you want restock pings and type /setup. That's it — the bot will post there from now on.

3
Get notified

Sit back. The bot monitors the stock 24/7 and pings your channel automatically every time the rotation changes.

✦ Alert Types

Three kinds of
pings.

🌟
Legendary Alert

When a legendary rarity seed appears in the shop, the bot sends an @everyone ping with a special gold embed so nobody in your server misses it.

🌠
Weather Event

Starfall, Thunderstorm, and other special weather events trigger their own dedicated alert with an @everyone ping the moment they become active.

🔁
Restock

Every rotation posts the full seed and gear list with rarities and quantities, plus current weather and live Roblox player count.

✦ Slash Commands

Everything at your
fingertips.

/setup
Set notification channel

Registers the current channel for restock pings. Requires Manage Channels permission.

/disable
Pause notifications

Stops all restock pings in your server until you run /setup again.

/calc
Crop value calculator

Computes the sell value of any crop given its stage, mutations, and color variant. Shows ROI and profit breakdown.

/mutations
Mutation reference

Displays all available mutations and their value multipliers in a clean reference card.

/status
Check setup status

Shows whether notifications are configured in the current server and which channel they're set to.

/setup-status
Live status channel

Turns the current channel into a live bot health indicator that auto-renames based on system status.

✦ FAQ

Common
questions.

Is GH Notify free? ▼
Yes, completely free. Add it to as many servers as you want with no limits and no paywalls.
What permissions does the bot need? ▼
GH Notify only needs Send Messages and Embed Links in whichever channel you point it to. No admin permissions, no access to member data.
How fast are the alerts? ▼
The bot checks every 30 seconds and syncs to the 5-minute game rotation cycle, so alerts fire within seconds of the actual restock.
Can I set up multiple notification channels? ▼
Each server gets one notification channel. Run /setup in the channel you want to use. To change it, just run /setup in a different channel.
What is the status channel feature? ▼
Run /setup-status in any voice or text channel and the bot will automatically rename it to reflect its health — ✅ status-online, ⚠️ status-degraded, 🔴 status-down, etc. Great for server transparency.
Is this an official Garden Horizons tool? ▼
GH Notify is an unofficial fan-made bot. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Garden Horizons game developers. It reads publicly available wiki data.
